pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit entering secondary orders unless primary position is locked in guaranteed profit of at least +$3.00.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require dynamic 5-period ATR volatility expansion check and enforce minimum 5-minute cooldown between consecutive entries on the same symbol.
profit_harvest_threshold: Enable dynamic trailing stop at +$3.00 unrealized profit and enforce partial harvest (50%) at +$6.00 to allow remaining exposure to target $15.00+.
